closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

手机号登录失败时，页面只显示固定文案“手机号验证未完成，请稍后重试。”，无论底层是验证码错误、验证码过期，还是 AGC 拒绝当前应用签名，用户看到的提示都一样，日志里也只有原始错误码，没有类别或修复方向。

本次复现中，底层真实错误是 AGC 认证服务返回 `code=12000006`（应用签名与 AGC 登记指纹不一致时出现）。同一时刻切到“使用华为账号登录”，页面能显示“应用签名与 AGC 配置不匹配，请检查证书指纹。”，说明华为账号路径已区分类别，而手机号路径把错误统一吞成了通用文案。

复现步骤：

1. 在模拟器上安装一个签名证书与 AGC 登记指纹不一致的构建（本次使用本地 release 证书签名，versionCode 10016）。
2. 启动应用，进入登录页。
3. 点击“手机号登录”，输入已注册手机号与任意验证码后点击“登录”。
4. 页面稳定显示“手机号验证未完成，请稍后重试。”；`hilog` 过滤 `DigitalMateAuth` 可见唯一线索：

```text
11-11 09:33:02.654  4204  4204 E A00000/DigitalMateAuth: Account credential failed: code=12000006
```

同一构建点击“使用华为账号登录”时，界面显示：

```text
应用签名与 AGC 配置不匹配，请检查证书指纹。
```

代码位置与原因：

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/account/CloudAccountService.ets` 的 `signIn()` 在 `credential.kind === 'phone'` 时，对任何异常都走 `credentialError(error, '手机号验证未完成，请稍后重试。')`，没有把 AGC 错误码传给用户可见文案。
- `credentialError()` 只映射 AGC 业务码（`203818032`、`203818129`、`203818134`、`203817986`、`203818038`、`203818039`、`203818081`）和网络错误码，`12000006` 落到 `fallback`。
- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/account/HuaweiAccountService.ets` 的 `huaweiLoginErrorMessage()` 已经为指纹不匹配（`1001500001`）准备了专门文案，但手机号路径没有复用这类分类。

期望行为：

1. 手机号登录失败时区分“验证码错误/失效”“验证码格式错误”“网络异常”“应用签名或 AGC 配置不匹配”等原因，给出可操作提示。
2. 至少把 AGC 原始错误码写进可见的诊断信息或结构化日志，避免只留下 `code=<数字>`。
3. “应用签名与 AGC 配置不匹配”这类环境问题应在登录入口统一提示，而不是按登录方式给出互相矛盾的文案。

说明：本次现象由本地非 AGC 登记证书签名触发，在 AGC 登记指纹的 debug 签名包上未复现登录失败。因此本 issue 聚焦“失败原因被统一吞掉、无法区分”的可诊断性缺陷，而不是要求应用在签名不匹配时完成登录。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 设备：DevEco Studio HarmonyOS 模拟器，HarmonyOS 6.0.0.130，API 22，分辨率 1280×2832。
- 主机：Windows 11，DevEco Studio 26.0，hvigor 构建。
- 应用：`com.jiuwen.digitalmate`，versionName 0.1.0，versionCode 10016，debug `buildMode` 的 `assembleHap` 产物。
- 签名：本地 release 证书（`DM-release-signing`），未在 AGC 登记同一指纹。
- 网络：模拟器网络正常，能访问 AGC 认证服务并返回业务错误码。
- 复现稳定性：每次登录均复现；切换华为账号登录也会提示签名与 AGC 不匹配。

### Additional Information

- 该构建安装后，升级启动恢复日志为 `DigitalMateUpdate: Upgrade startup recovery completed: version=10016, route=signed_out`，随后进入登录页，与“签名变化导致本地会话不可用”一致。
- 若能提供把 AGC 错误码映射到用户文案的统一入口，可同时覆盖登录、绑定、验证码重发等路径，避免各调用点各自兜底。

### Version Information

- 客户端源码：`feat/session-artifact-history` 分支，commit `dd62f89ca6f484dc3a459941246e9ecf581c6c99`
- 应用版本：versionName `0.1.0`，versionCode `10016`
- AGC Auth SDK：随工程 `@hw-agconnect/auth` 依赖引入，具体版本未单独记录
- 设备系统：HarmonyOS `6.0.0.130`（API 22）

### Screenshots / Recordings

![手机号登录只显示通用失败文案](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/fd0e1de19a3a1fc443682634bb1b6d72e9cfa1d7/.github/issue-assets/login-agc-signature/phone-login-error.jpeg)

![华为账号登录提示应用签名与 AGC 配置不匹配](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/fd0e1de19a3a1fc443682634bb1b6d72e9cfa1d7/.github/issue-assets/login-agc-signature/agc-fingerprint-mismatch.jpeg)

- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

鸿蒙 App 连上云端 WebSocket 之后，只要连接还活着，就会一直挂着，**一段时间没有收到消息也不会主动断开**。

现状（main 上已核对）：
- `DigitalMateSocket` 只有 **75 秒握手超时**，握手成功后定时器会被清掉，之后没有空闲断开。
- `DigitalMateClient` 的默认 **45 秒** 是单次请求超时，不是空闲断连。
- 切到后台时 `setForeground(false)` 只会暂停重连，**不会**主动关掉已打开的 socket。

这会让长连接一直占着，费电费流量，也可能让假活连接一直占着云端会话。

**复现：**
1. 打开 App，连上云端 WebSocket。
2. 不发送新消息，也没有进行中的任务或流式回复。
3. 等待一段时间（空闲时长待定，实现时做成命名常量，默认值待产品拍板）。

**实际结果：** 连接一直保持打开，客户端不会因无消息而主动断开。

**预期结果：** 一段时间没有收到业务下行后，App 主动断开 WebSocket。关闭原因应标明是空闲断开，而不是连接异常；前台不要立刻走 `fail()` → `scheduleRecovery()` 自动重连（否则等于没断）。用户回到会话、回到前台、或准备发下一条消息时再重连。流式回复、pending 请求、进行中的任务不算空闲；协议心跳也不应单独把空闲计时一直续上。

已检索仓库 issue，没有专门跟踪「空闲无下行后主动断开 WS」的条目（[#135](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/135) 是冷启动同时开两条 socket，不是这件事）。本条由原 Feature 表单改写为 Bug。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- App：DigitalMate 鸿蒙客户端
- 代码位置：`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/digitalmate/DigitalMateSocket.ets`、`DigitalMateClient.ets`；横幅文案见 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets`
- 对照分支：main
- 关联：长工具调用静默见 [#896](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/896)、[#398](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/398)；若提醒只走这条 WS、没有系统通知，见 [#460](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/460)

### Additional Information

修复落在客户端连接层，不需要新的云端业务 API。空闲时长未指定，确定后补进本 issue。Web 端是否同样做可另开，不阻塞 App。

### Version Information

对照 main 当前客户端连接实现；发布版本未另测。空闲时长待定。

### Screenshots / Recordings

无界面截图：这是连接层缺失行为（连上后无空闲断开），用代码核对说明，不是界面复现图。

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:A03 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A03`.

**Outcome:** Commit context revision, answer and terminal through one authoritative transaction.

**Owner:** Session Store owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch
- Only the named owning module/interface and listed tests are delivered here; downstream feature migration and final traffic activation are separate tasks. When this module is selected, the production composition must use its public owner path without fallback.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Commit context revision, answer and terminal through one authoritative transaction, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py::EngineStore.claim; EngineStore.recover_submission` into `server/agent_service/session_store/context.py; server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/session_store/context.py; server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py) — `EngineStore.claim; EngineStore.recover_submission`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/backend/host_api/turn.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/backend/host_api/turn.py) — `TurnContext, execute_turn`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Admitted immutable prefix
- Tool-call/result pairing
- Historical records retain their original revision meaning

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/session_store/context.py
- server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a03.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

<!-- DM31:A02-FULFILLED:f437:751 -->
**A02 component input fulfilled:** [#750 completed original-scope acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/750#issuecomment-6720921801) is integrated through [PR930](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/930#issuecomment-6720921476) at actual main `f437635b363e50c2c0197329c742f5462e2ae211`. Canonical Store producer and distinct default legacy admission owner transfer retain separate identities/evidence. The native #750 dependency is retained as **closed fulfilled component history**. This issue remains OPEN for its own implementation/integration acceptance and every other prerequisite; no canonical activation, populated conversion, deployment or unchanged-client acceptance follows.
<!-- /DM31:A02-FULFILLED:f437:751 -->

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/750) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED component input; native history retained**)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A04](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/752), [DM31-A06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/754), [DM31-G03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/767)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Stale revision rejects without partial commit
- Later writes cannot mutate the admitted start snapshot
- Duplicate or late finalization cannot regress terminal state

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a03

**Cases:** - Prefix/CAS multi-connection tests
- Final-write failure and reopen
- Paired tool context roundtrip

**Participants:** Real Store context/final CAS over independent SQLite connections; deterministic competing revisions and injected write failure. No Harness/provider needed.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** foundation, history. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR0001, ADR0004, host-operation-lifecycle.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**已证实范围：正常 managed Native 准入选择已授权、可保留的本地 Message Source 后，初始 revision pin 未被生产/保存在 Task。** 实际归一化 UserMessage attachment 已有该 Source 的 revision `1`，实际 admission Task 也保存了 `source_ids`，但 `evidence_revisions={}`。随后真实 HCE `select_preparation` 在当前 full-head evidence capture 中因缺失 pin 拒绝，发生在初始 preparation（P）、SDK/model send、Start 和 final 之前。

本轮使用真实 Main 的普通 `Engine.request(EngineRequest(action='task.create', run=True, source_ids=...))`，实际 managed admission、RunClaims 和 HCE/evidence gate。没有通过 post-admission Task patch 填/删 pin。Source 由实际 owner 注册；对应 synthetic 本地 Message 可由实际 Task reader 读取，visibility=true、retention=true。**不是 Source 无权限/不可读/retain=false 的前置拒绝，也不是 #1086 已手工 pin 后的 final 呈现拒绝。**

**期望**：正常选择合法 finite local Message Source 的准入 producer，应保留已选 attachment 的初始 revision 事实供后续实际 HCE 准备校验；不应要求测试或 caller 准入后自行 patch Task。当前 evidence gate 对缺少事实的严格拒绝不应被绕过。

| 实际 RunClaims 后 HCE.select_preparation | 成功，真实 P 存在 | `ContextUnavailable`，P 不存在 |
| SDK/provider/model | 0 | 0 |
| Source 拒绝后的持久化 | — | 独立 reader whole SQLite dump 不变；Start=0、final=0、backend history=0 |

真实 normative 结果：**2 tests / 1 PASS / 1 assertion FAIL / 0 ERROR / 0 SKIP / exit 1**。unittest 输出耗时 **0.796 s**；完整诊断记录 **0.8108323329943232 s**，两者口径分别保留。无 Source 对照是真实 owner 成功，Source case 没有被改为 expected-refusal PASS。

2. 使用正常 Engine.request 的 task.create/run=True/source_ids 入口；只把 `engine.max_active=0` 作为有界调度控制，让该正常请求排队，不自动进入外部 executor，request 后恢复为 10。

4. 使用实际 `RunClaims.prepare/commit`，然后直接调用实际 `HCE.select_preparation(task)`，隔离初始 P seam；无 Source 对照成功，Source case 抛出下述错误。

源码依据：[正常 admission Task 记录 source_ids](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/5b2f2b03ff47352490ff2a47619c3ee69f6e8108/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/admission.py#L225)、[HCE.select_preparation](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/5b2f2b03ff47352490ff2a47619c3ee69f6e8108/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/context_execution.py#L298)、[capture_full_head_origin 的严格事实校验](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/5b2f2b03ff47352490ff2a47619c3ee69f6e8108/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/evidence.py#L77)。观察支持当前正常 admission initial-pin producer 的缺口；不将候选测试问题或部署状态当成此 Main 反例。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 日期：2026-11-11（Asia/Shanghai）；native CPython **3.13.13 / Clang22.1.3**；macOS **26.6.2 / arm64**，临时实际 file-backed SQLite、独立 reader；已有声明依赖。
- 真实参与方：Engine.request / managed admission projection / WorkspaceAuthority / Store / Repository / RunClaims / HostedContextExecution / SessionEvidenceGate，实际 Source reader/visibility/retention。
- 明确控制：`max_active=0` 只让普通 request 排队；随后实际 claim / preparation。原 ScriptedBackend 仅作 admission descriptor，外部 `engine.execute` 设为若被调用即失败的控制，实测调用数 **0**。没有替换被验证的 Store、Source policy、admission、claim 或 P owner，没有准入后 Task pin patch。

- 实际复用既有物理 export（记录的 commit `13e329976e081d9f179cc44e1e3830495561a9c6`）与本次 Main 的完整 tree 相同；**142 loaded repository origins** 逐项对 Main Git blobs 核验，0 mismatch。发布人再次独立核对同142个 blobs，不把历史13e测试 PASS 移标为 Main 运行。

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version. 精确 Main 已观察到下述四个反例；发布前最新 Main 的 Store 和三个 fixture blob 相同，未重跑该较新版本。
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

在显式 `hosted_sessions=True, hosted_context=True` 的真实源码集成中，通用 `EngineStore.create/update` 可以绕开 canonical final 成功写边界，产生互相冲突的业务记录；真实 V2 final 完整提交后，公共 update 还允许将已完成 Task 回退为 running。

**期望**：context-owned run 的成功 Task/Run/result Message 只能在为该 run 正式签发的 canonical final stage 中发布；已提交成功终态不应被通用写入回退。普通 metadata 写入与受支持的其他模式仍需各自遵守原有契约。

**已完成的四项实际观察**：

| 公共入口 / 前置 | 实际结果 | canonical 记录 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 真实 admit + claim 后，update Task 为 completed 并提交 synthetic result | update 成功，读取 Task.status 为 completed | final 前后均不存在；dm turn 仍 RUNNING |
| 真实 admit + claim + start seal 后，create successful Run | create 成功；Run count 0 → 1 | final 不存在；Task running / dm turn RUNNING |
| 同一类真实 setup 后，create kind=result Message | create 成功，无已签发 final stage | final 不存在；Task running / dm turn RUNNING |
| 先真实 V2 stage_turn 完整 outer commit，再 public update Task 为 running 并提交 synthetic result | Task completed → running；public result update 也被接受 | dm turn 保持 COMPLETED，final count=1，canonical 原 answer 不变 |

后三项独立 fixture 的原始 state tuples（依次为 Task.status、dm turn state、canonical session revision、该 run 的 final count、Run count）：

```text
success Run: before [running, RUNNING, 2, 0, 0] -> after [running, RUNNING, 2, 0, 1]
result Message: before [running, RUNNING, 2, 0, 0] -> after [running, RUNNING, 2, 0, 0]
late update: before [completed, COMPLETED, 3, 1, 1] -> after [running, COMPLETED, 3, 1, 1]
```

Message count 不是上述 tuple 的字段；该项证据是公共 create 实际返回成功，不把 tuple 未变误称为“没有写入”。late update 的保留 canonical answer 仍为 fixture 的 `Immutable R1 answer`。未据此声称外部 model/provider 或线上用户已受影响。

**最小复现核心**（在现有真实 owner fixture 上；不 fake Store/final owner）：

```python
# ContextExecutionTests: real admit + claim
accepted, receipt, *_ = await self.admit('synthetic-A03-writer-boundary')
await self.claim(accepted)
task = self.engine.task(accepted.turn_id)
task.status = 'completed'
task.result = 'synthetic terminal outside final'
self.store.update('task', task, task.revision)
# actual: Task completed; read_run_context(receipt.identity).final is None

# Independent ActualWorkspaceV2RepositoryTests setup for each case:
self.store.create('run', Run(id='synthetic-unissued-run', host_id='synthetic',
    provider='synthetic', task_id=self.accepted.turn_id,
    status='completed', result='synthetic'))
self.store.create('message', Message(id='synthetic-unissued-message', room_id='home',
    task_id=self.accepted.turn_id, actor_id='digitalmate', kind='result', text='synthetic'))

# Separate late-regression fixture: actual V2 final owner and outer commit
with self.store.transaction():
    stage = self.store.open_hosted_context_retryable_final(self.identity)
    publication, command, _ = self.bind_initial(stage)
    HostedContextStoreProxy(self.store, final=stage).stage_turn(command)
task = self.engine.task(self.accepted.turn_id)
task.status = 'running'
task.result = 'synthetic late replacement'
self.store.update('task', task, task.revision)
# actual: Task running; canonical final remains COMPLETED / original answer
```

真实执行命令：在下述精确源码 checkout，使用已声明的本地依赖，`python3.13 -I -S -B - < probe-generic-task-original-stdin.py`；以及 `python3.13 -I -S -B probe-public-writes.py`。后一脚本选择恰好三个观察 case，继承仓库现有 fixture 的实际 setUp/tearDown。原 stdin 输入已按执行时工具输入逐字保存，未重跑。后者 **3 tests / 2.486 s / 0 error / 0 failure**，这是漏洞观察完成状态，**不是正确性契约 PASS**。另有 unchanged baseline **172 tests / 0 failure / 0 error / 0 skip**，仍未修复。

源码入口：[EngineStore.create](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bfd3c0fc5625ff5d930a29a838ed210f89933840/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py#L3010)、[EngineStore.update](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bfd3c0fc5625ff5d930a29a838ed210f89933840/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py#L3229)、[真实 V2 fixture setup/state/bind_initial](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bfd3c0fc5625ff5d930a29a838ed210f89933840/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_context_final_v2_actual_workspace.py#L65)、[真实原 ContextExecution fixture](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bfd3c0fc5625ff5d930a29a838ed210f89933840/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_context_execution.py)。

### Checklist

- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version inspected: Main 29516ada27d0e9aac208cb0c536f96c9ee42de28.
- [x] Environment information, minimal reproduction, and complete native import tracebacks are provided below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

Main's ordinary G09 `server-contracts` suite recursively discovers two newly introduced trajectory modules. They import SDK-only dependencies at module scope, while ordinary G09 publishes only the installed Root contract package, base Bridge dependencies, and Bridge source/test paths. The SDK dependencies/source paths are confined to two separately selected configured workers. As a result, ordinary test collection aborts before those test bodies execute.

The defect is present on Main, independently of the private receiving branch: `232fbeef3a306c877ae6f7053a5d04a142fbc218` introduces both files, its parent `c69b76608b4d5d74ddebc27bd3846ccc8b7a1d34` lacks both, and their blobs are unchanged at inspected Main. Expected behavior: every module selected by the ordinary suite must collect under that suite's declared, bounded dependency/path environment while retaining all required test obligations.

Minimal reproduction from a local clone (no download, product changes, or test execution):

```python
# Run with python3.13 -I -S -B from a local DigitalMate clone.
# Each exact Main file fails at the first undeclared SDK/OTel import.
import subprocess, tempfile, pathlib, runpy
commit = "29516ada27d0e9aac208cb0c536f96c9ee42de28"
for name in ("test_gateway_trajectory.py", "test_workswarm_runtime_phase.py"):
    data = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{commit}:tests/server/{name}"])
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        path = pathlib.Path(directory) / name
        path.write_bytes(data)
        try:
            runpy.run_path(str(path), run_name="collection_probe")
        except ModuleNotFoundError:
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
```

A stronger independent native replay used the unmodified Main `scripts/ci/server-tests.py:build_suite` with its original registry markers and only the discovery filename narrowed; it added the Bridge source/test path slots and reused the existing ordinary-like native installed target (SDK and OTel absent). Actual independent diagnostic command: `python3.13 -I -S -B reproduce.py`. Its exit 0 asserts that both native collection attempts failed with ModuleNotFoundError; it does not mean either selected test passed. No test setup/body executed.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Host: macOS Darwin 25.6.0, Apple arm64.
- Interpreter: uv-managed CPython 3.13.13, Clang 22.1.3; invoked with `-I -S -B`.
- Ordinary-like dependencies: existing CPython 3.13 native installed target. The target has base Bridge/contract dependencies; `jiuwenswarm`, `openjiuwen`, and `opentelemetry` directories are absent. No configured SDK target or SDK source roots were added.
- Collection only: exact Main runner/test bytes, filename-only narrowed selector; no test body or setup executed. This is not a fresh Linux/Docker dependency installation, full G09 run, or installed-byte verification. The narrow target combines owner and dependency storage.
- Source inspection: ordinary `prepare_dependencies` installs root+base Bridge without optional extras; `publish_child_paths` exposes rootSite and `/deps`; `server_context_source` dependencies/source roots are restricted to its separately selected workers.

### Additional Information

The two files contain 1+8 expected test IDs (AST count, not execution). Do not mark blocked tests skipped, report them as PASS, silently expand ordinary SDK authority, or reclassify the historical Native9fc6 full run. Acceptance should verify the intended suite/dependency integration with exact required identities and no skip, including the bounded ordinary profile and configured workers.

Read-only repository searches for the two test filenames, ModuleNotFoundError, bug server-contracts, trajectory PRs, and SDK+G09 PRs found no direct duplicate at triage time. Related migration work is tracked separately. Publisher fresh searches also checked closed #1038 (a bootstrap gate expectation mismatch) and open PR #588 (optional runtime dependency packaging); neither describes this ordinary recursive trajectory collection regression. This code integration mismatch is separate from Docker daemon availability; daemon recovery does not provide these undeclared modules.

- Exact tested tree: `dc1cf96389206439a3fce93e9479ebc7675dc6b0`; all 29 materialized Main source blobs were checked against Git objects at publication. Fresh remote Main remained `29516ada27d0e9aac208cb0c536f96c9ee42de28`.

Both original failure tracebacks and the limitations are shown; no collection or test execution was repeated to make the screenshot.

### Checklist

- [x] 已搜索仓库内相关 issue，未找到同一问题（相近 issue 已在正文注明区别）。
- [x] 已提供群内原始反馈、截图与场景版本。
- [x] 已按群公告的「现象 / 预期 / 场景」格式整理。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：助手在解释自己「为什么访问不到本地代码仓」时，把云侧沙箱的内部路径和运行环境信息直接写进回答正文，用户看到 `/data/state/home`、`overlay`、`gvisor`、`9p` 这类只有工程师才需要的细节。

群内原始反馈（2026-11-02 17:30，夏华梁，按群公告格式提交）：

> 现象：回答结果中存在云侧的路径
> 预期：回答结果中不体现云侧的路径，对用户不感知
> 场景：v0.1.6 版本

截图中的原文（红框处）：

> 云侧目录。`/data/state/home` 是云沙箱里挂载进来的服务器侧目录，不是你手机本地的存储。判断依据（刚刚抓到的实际环境信息）：
> · 文件系统类型：`df -T` 显示它属于 overlay 类型，挂载点是 `/data/state`……
> · 运行环境：`uname` 显示内核为 Linux 4.19.8-gvisor……
> · 挂载方式：`/data/state` 与容器根目录（`/overlay`）是两个独立挂载，9p 是宿主（云侧）向沙箱共享目录的典型方式……
> · 目录内容：……里面有 `.cache`、`.jiuwenwarm`、`.local`、`.Documents`……

复现步骤：
1. 问「你能访问 DigitalMate 代码仓吗」，再追问「/data/state/home 是手机本机目录还是云侧目录」。
2. 观察回答正文。

实际结果：把沙箱路径、内核标识、挂载类型等内部实现细节原样输出。
预期结果：
- 面向用户的结论只说「这是云端工作区，不是本机目录」，路径与环境信息不进正文。
- 需要排查时把 `df`/`uname`/挂载信息写进诊断日志，不进气泡。
- 若必须展示存储位置，用产品化命名（如「云端工作区」），而不是 `/data/state`。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：DigitalMate / Beebou 手机端
- 版本：v0.1.6（报告人明确标注）
- 系统：HarmonyOS（截图为 5G/4G 移动网络）
- 云端：Orbit 云对话（云沙箱 gvisor `/data/state` 工作区）
- 反馈来源：DigitalMate 内测群，2026-11-02（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 与 #234（已关闭，「聊天正文暴露沙箱运行时诊断和安装命令」）同类但不同点：#234 是执行期把安装/诊断命令贴出来，本条是**解释性回答**主动罗列沙箱内部路径与环境探测结果，说明脱敏规则没有覆盖「模型自述环境」这条路径。
- 与 #407（裸露 base64）、#330（DSML 原文泄漏）同属「内部实现泄漏」家族，建议统一在输出侧加一道过滤。

### Version Information

- App 版本：v0.1.6
- 反馈时间：2026-11-02 17:30（Asia/Shanghai）

### Screenshots / Recordings

![回答正文暴露 /data/state 等云侧沙箱路径](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261102/20261102_1730_cloud_path_leak.jpg?raw=true)

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:A05 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A05`.

**Outcome:** Prepare selected implementations at startup, retain effective bindings for new S, resolve original factories for existing S.

**Owner:** Registry owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch
- Only the named owning module/interface and listed tests are delivered here; downstream feature migration and final traffic activation are separate tasks. When this module is selected, the production composition must use its public owner path without fallback.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Prepare selected implementations at startup, retain effective bindings for new S, resolve original factories for existing S, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/workswarm_adapter.py::WorkSwarmAdapter.mode_for; open_scoped_session` into `server/agent_service/registry/proxy.py; server/agent_service/backend/profile_loader.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/registry/proxy.py; server/agent_service/backend/profile_loader.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/workswarm_adapter.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/workswarm_adapter.py) — `WorkSwarmAdapter.mode_for; open_scoped_session`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/registry/proxy.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/registry/proxy.py) — `ImplementationRef, RegistryProxy.register/prepare/resolve`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/backend/profile_loader.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/backend/profile_loader.py) — `ProfileLoader, HarnessFactory`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Core8f9 and product-override provenance
- Historical providers

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**

- Registration treated as readiness

**Writable boundary:**

### Checklist

- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version examined: Main13 `13d74281a67cf2a72ee1eb03acd1669f7d138ede`.
- [x] Environment information and a minimal reproducible demo are included below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

The trusted snapshot transport test fails on current Main13 before candidate architecture policy enforcement. `ServerSnapshotsTest.seed_production_sources()` copies only the two production roots. The trusted policy now has a finite registration, so `select_policy()` requires the exact acceptance anchor in the temporary fixture. The scanner correctly exits 2 with empty stdout. `checker()` immediately calls `json.loads(result.stdout)` and hides the actionable stderr behind JSONDecodeError.

Actual job: [Architecture CI run 42806629273, job 129797318822](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42806629273/job/129797318822). Its trusted selector/base is `13d74281a67cf2a72ee1eb03acd1669f7d138ede`; the run examines PR #1021 head `05385e63f61011ed6be5f18a77b6b24c321204f4`. The snapshot suite has 25 passes and one error among 26 tests; candidate policy enforcement has not run. This is independently reproducible from Main13's own sources with no candidate code.

From a local checkout of Main13, run the original test with only the Python standard library and Git:

```sh
PYTHONPATH=tests/ci python3 -B -m unittest test_server_snapshots.ServerSnapshotsTest.test_real_scanner_legal_export_and_archive_hidden_forbidden_engine_import -v
```

A smaller demonstration of the scanner's underlying error, from that same exact checkout:

```python
import json, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
policy = root / 'docs/plans/v31-server-migration/module-ownership.json'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    fixture = pathlib.Path(directory)
    for relative in json.loads(policy.read_text())['roots']:
        shutil.copytree(root / relative, fixture / relative)
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(root / 'tools/architecture/check.py'),
        '--policy', str(policy), '--root', str(fixture), '--format', 'json'],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    print('returncode:', result.returncode)
    print('stdout:', repr(result.stdout))
    print('stderr:', result.stderr)
```

Actual scanner result on both local Python versions:

```text
returncode: 2
stdout: ''
stderr: invalid architecture scan: missing regular control/source file: docs/adr/g01-finite-activation-acceptance.json
```

Full hosted exception traceback:

```text
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/actions-runner/_work/DigitalMate/DigitalMate/selector/tests/ci/test_server_snapshots.py", line 288, in test_real_scanner_legal_export_and_archive_hidden_forbidden_engine_import
    status, report = self.checker(self.runner_temp / "dm31/candidate")
                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/opt/actions-runner/_work/DigitalMate/DigitalMate/selector/tests/ci/test_server_snapshots.py", line 268, in checker
    return result.returncode, json.loads(result.stdout)
                              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/lib/python3.12/json/__init__.py", line 346, in loads
    return _default_decoder.decode(s)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/lib/python3.12/json/decoder.py", line 337, in decode
    obj, end = self.raw_decode(s, idx=_w(s, 0).end())
               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/lib/python3.12/json/decoder.py", line 355, in raw_decode
    raise JSONDecodeError("Expecting value", s, err.value) from None
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
```

Expected: the legal raw/depth-1 snapshot should pass, an archive that hides the injected import should appear clean, and the raw snapshot retaining the forbidden import should fail with AR01. Independently adding the exact Main13 control documents to private diagnostic fixtures yields a legal dormant scan with 283 files / 38 checked and zero findings; injecting the original forbidden import yields one AR01 with exit 1. The complete original test method also passes on CPython 3.13.13 when only its private fixture seeding is supplied the three exact Main13 control files: all three real checker subprocesses return 0 / 0 / 1 with 0 / 0 / 1 findings. No test source or scanner source is changed for that diagnostic. The production selector must keep rejecting incomplete control sets; the fix belongs in fixture completeness and error diagnostics.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Hosted job: Linux runner, CPython 3.12, GitHub Actions trusted/selector snapshot transport suite.
- Independent local reproduction: macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), arm64; Git 2.54.0 (Apple Git-157); CPython 3.11.2 and 3.13.13.
- Python standard library and existing local Git objects only; no Docker, SDK, network fetch or candidate-code execution required.
- Version distinction: the installed old CPython 3.11.2 reproduces the initial error; with diagnostic fixture controls added, it later fails at `extractall(filter="data")`, which that old minor does not support. CPython 3.13.13 completes the full diagnostic test. This later 3.11 limitation is separate from the initial fixture defect and the hosted 3.12 failure.

### Version Information

Trusted main/base/selector: `13d74281a67cf2a72ee1eb03acd1669f7d138ede`.
PR #1021 candidate observed in hosted job: `05385e63f61011ed6be5f18a77b6b24c321204f4`.
The original test, transport scripts, scanner and parser have identical bytes at both revisions. Main13 alone reproduces the defect; this is not evidence of an H2-only source/policy failure.

### Screenshots / Recordings

![Actual Main13 reproduction report screenshot](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/cea75dfe8c4d90467d44bb3f1e95df594abadf4c/.github/assets/snapshot-transport-main13-repro-20261110.png?raw=true)

This is a real isolated-browser screenshot of the saved reproduction report and subprocess results, not a hosted terminal capture. Original test/scanner source was unchanged; no repository fix was applied before filing.

Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** docs/plans/v31-server-migration/module-ownership.json; tools/architecture/manifest.py (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Architecture reference [docs/protocols/boundaries.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/protocols/boundaries.md) — `Ownership table`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/protocols/project-layout.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/protocols/project-layout.md) — `Placement table`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/memory/catalog.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/memory/catalog.py) — `EngineMemory`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_sources.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_sources.py) — `source ownership module`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Main memory, sources, artifacts, routing persistence, existing mobile behavior

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Unowned modules and ambiguous writers from the plan

**Writable boundary:**
- docs/plans/v31-server-migration/module-ownership.json
- tools/architecture/manifest.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** None; may start from the frozen evidence.

**Blocks:** [DM31-G11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/747). The registry prerequisite for [DM31-G02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/744) was delivered in #841.

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/738), [DM31-A14](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/739), [DM31-A19](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/740), [DM31-A20](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/741)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

**Verification and evidence**

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Inventory Runtime, Router, gateways, backend, HostAPI, Manager, Store, Harness, providers, old entry/executors
- Distinct navigation/attachment/memory/source domains cannot grant access to Session Store tables
- All new modules require registration; legacy exceptions expire by cutover

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 tools/architecture/manifest.py --check docs/plans/v31-server-migration/module-ownership.json

**Assertions:** - Validate unique source ownership and domain writer
- Review exact public interface inventory with module owners

**Participants:** Actual scanner and legal/violating fixtures; runtime suites use real owning public components/SQLite with controlled providers. G05 physically omits Core in its isolated installation. No phone/device claim.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** named-module-owners, approved-target-layout. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR01, AR03, AR06, AR07, AR10.

Duplicate search found #1038 is explicitly test-only and #1041 covers only `docs/current-status.md`; #1014 owns the dedicated runner. This issue is the separate two-file documentation follow-up.

Correct only `docs/developer_guide/ci.md` and `docs/updates/2026-11-10-temporary-local-server-ci.md`: distinguish the dated initial two-job pause from #1027's partial restoration, describe current aggregation and server-only dispatch limits, and retain fresh full independently reviewed local receipts for every exact candidate. Preserve all other applicable native CI requirements, no skipped-result promotion to PASS, no bypass, and reviewed restoration of the remaining paused server job. Verify source claims and edited links; no workflow or test behavior changes.

DigitalMate v3.1; freshly fetched main `f02f5d8a715b416d3503f9a2c50868917cd09b7c`; original pause baseline `728927dab555c355f5b5e366be3dd2a17e7babb5`; architecture restoration PR #1027 merged at `e3e640668c6ac0ac49e09b2a823bb6f109176598` on 2026-11-10. Historical observations retain their original source and limits.

closed_recent.author: hlXia-mm
closed_recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

希望 Digital Mate 在对话的图片输入和图片输出环节支持可视化图片预览，用户可以直接看到图片内容，并点击查看大图，减少仅凭文件名辨认附件的成本。

用户提供的对比：
- 图一为 Digital Mate：上传 JPG 后，对话中显示文件名和通用附件卡（JPG、2.4 MB），没有直接展示该图片的缩略图；助手能够给出图片内容的文字解读，但用户难以在同一对话中直观核对输入图片。
- 图二为豆包：输入图片直接以可视化缩略图展示，回复中包含图片和文字混排，可作为图片呈现与交互的信息架构参考。

本需求聚焦图片展示与预览体验，不把对照回复中的站名、检索结论或参考图片内容当作已核实事实，也不要求复刻竞品的搜索或生成能力。

### Design Ideas

1. **输入图片预览**：选择图片后、发送前显示缩略图，便于确认选图；发送后在对应用户消息中展示图片缩略图，保留文件名或必要的格式信息。多图时按发送顺序排列，能够区分各张图片。
2. **输出图片预览**：助手实际返回生成图片、图片附件或可访问的检索图片时，在回复中展示可视化预览，而不是只显示通用文件图标或文件名；文字说明与对应图片保持明确关联。仅有文字解读时不强制生成或补造图片。
3. **查看大图**：点击输入或输出图片打开大图预览，支持缩放查看和返回原对话；多图可切换。返回后保留对话滚动位置与输入草稿。
4. **加载与降级**：显示加载状态；下载失败、原图不可用、权限失效或格式不支持时给出明确提示和重试/文件方式入口，不显示永久空白或错误成功状态。
5. **性能和边界**：缩略图按需加载并限制解码尺寸；大图在打开时再获取，避免长图、大图、多图导致卡顿或内存异常。图片访问复用现有账号鉴权和附件权限，不能为预览公开用户原图或在链接中暴露凭据。

### Involved Public APIs

优先复用现有附件、产物读取与图片展示能力；评审图片标识、media type、缩略图与原图可访问性、加载失败状态是否足够。只有现有字段不足时再设计兼容的增量协议，不由客户端根据文件名猜测图片内容或权限。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- 客户端：图片选择/发送草稿区、聊天附件卡、助手回复图片渲染、大图查看器及历史恢复。
- 云端附件与产物：提供有权限的图片读取和必要元数据，保证缩略图与原图对应同一附件/产物。
- 与 #356（多图解读质量）相关但范围不同：本 Issue 只跟踪输入/输出的图片展示和预览，不以图片解读正确性或检索效果作为实现完成依据。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 单图：选择 JPG/PNG 后检查发送前缩略图、发送后用户消息缩略图、大图打开/缩放/返回；对照用户提供的通用附件卡场景。
- 多图：顺序、图片与文字对应关系、预览切换正确，不串图、不丢图。
- 输出：助手真实返回图片附件/产物时能够预览；纯文字解读不出现空图片占位或虚构配图。
- 恢复：重新进入历史、重启应用后仍可按权限查看已发送和已返回图片；返回对话不丢草稿和滚动位置。
- 异常：断网、图片下载失败、附件删除、权限失效及不支持格式均有明确降级；可恢复时支持重试。
- 性能/UI：验证大图、长图、多图、不同屏幕尺寸与字体下的解码内存、滚动流畅度和显示比例，不拉伸、不遮挡；验收时提供真机截图或录屏。

### Additional Information

证据：用户提供的两张手机对比截图，状态栏时间均为20:50；截图未显示 Digital Mate 的版本号、构建号、手机型号或系统版本，待验证时补充。本次仅提交需求，未进行代码复现或修复。

**图一：Digital Mate 当前图片输入与文字解读呈现**

![Digital Mate 图片输入与输出现状](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/fc06872bebdd85f1011c47ec714dfae96a41ba7e/docs/issue-evidence/ucd-20261107/image-preview-digitalmate-before-20261108.jpg?raw=true)

**图二：豆包图片输入及图文回复参考**

![豆包图片缩略图与图文回复参考](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/7a9881dcdaf0d130a5e3f74061270e0491e32386/docs/issue-evidence/ucd-20261107/image-preview-doubao-reference-20261108.jpg?raw=true)

### 📚 Documentation Issue Description

**类型说明**：本 issue 是 round-10 的 research/审计记录。本仓库没有 `research` 标签，且本轮硬约束禁止新建标签，因此使用既有的 `documentation` / `type:docs` 标签承载；审计正文见 `docs/product/p2-proactive-audit.md`（同一 PR）。

**审计对象**：`openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate` main，commit `04621bb`（2026-10-31 UTC）。

**一句话结论**：P2「主动但不越界」在当前 main 上没有发布态能力——每日 BIM 提醒没有任何发布构建可达的调度路径，也没有任何用户可见的开关或撤销入口。第 8 轮 #427 的「提醒文案双语」修复因此属于不可达的潜在代码。

**Headline facts（精确 file:line，逐条可在代码中复核）**

1. 每日提醒调度 `runDailyBimSentinel(now, scheduleNext = true)`（`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:5499`）全仓只有定义与唯一调用点 `Index.ets:5549`，调用方传 `false`；因此 `Index.ets:5524` 的 `shouldScheduleBimDailyReminder(...)` 永远为 false，`Index.ets:5525` 的 `scheduleNext(now)` 永不执行。
2. 唯一能让它运行的是 debug 构建：`Index.ets:5541` `if (!this.isDebugBuild) { ... return; }`，`isDebugBuild` 来自 `Index.ets:4904`，最终取 `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/update/AppUpdateService.ets:13` `return info.appInfo.debug;`。
3. 应用内唯一触发是 debug-only 按钮：`pages/A2uiHome/components/BimHomePage.ets:424` `if (bimSentinelDebugActionVisible(this.isDebugBuild)) {` / `:425` `Button('10秒测试 Sentinel')` → `Index.ets:8457` → `Index.ets:5552 scheduleBimSentinelMock()` → `Index.ets:5561 scheduleDebug(10)`；外部 want 入口同样被 `EntryAbility.ets:280` `if (!debugBuild) { return false; }` 挡住（`debugBuild` 来自 `EntryAbility.ets:449` 的 `isAppUpdateDebugBuild()`）。
4. 没有任何用户可见的授权/撤销：`pages/Settings/Index.ets`（94 行）不含任何 `提醒 / Reminder / notification` 字样；`pages/A2uiHome/bim/BimDailyReminder.ets` 无 `cancelReminder`。对照：开售提醒有 `pages/A2uiHome/train/SystemOneShotScheduler.ets:105` / `:124` 的取消路径，生产入口 `Index.ets:7496`。
5. 今天用户看到什么：发布构建没有 BIM 提醒；debug 构建点「10 秒测试 Sentinel」会请求通知权限后发布**中文**定时提醒 `title: '检查心上事（测试）'`（`BimDailyReminder.ets:105`）/ `content: '10 秒测试提醒'`（`:106`），中英文设备完全一致（#427 未合入；每日文案 `:81`/`:82` 同样仍是中文）。

**现状与差距**

- 现状：P2 只有一段不可达的提醒构造/调度代码 + 一个 debug 测试按钮，没有授权、没有撤销、没有发布触发。
- 差距：定位要求「在合适的时候主动帮助我，同时让我清楚知道它能做什么、不能做什么」；当前 main 在发布态既不会主动，也没有可治理边界。

**验收标准（本 issue 的范围）**

- [x] 新增 `docs/product/p2-proactive-audit.md`，包含上述 file:line 证据、每条 claim 的 `[fact] / [inference] / [assumption]` 标记、以及「最小 opt-in + 可关闭设计」的选项（成本/风险，不是决定）。
- [x] 新增 `tests/unit/p2-proactive-audit.test.mjs`，把文档中的每条引用钉到真实源文件行内容：行号移动、行内容变化、设置页出现提醒开关、`BimDailyReminder.ets` 出现 `cancelReminder` 都会失败。
- [x] 不改变任何用户可见行为。

**非目标检查**：不接提醒触发、不加设置开关、不启用任何通知、不改定位/边界、不改服务端；不新增 `.ets` 模块、不引入依赖、不新建标签、不改仓库设置。

**风险**：文档结论依赖 `04621bb` 的行号；一旦代码移动，锚定测试会先失败（这是预期保护，不是回归）。

**优先级**：P0（它直接决定 P2 是否只是宣称）。
**预估**：0.5 人日（文档 + 锚定测试；不含任何行为改动）。单位统一为人日（第 22 轮 F5）。

**相关链接**
- 审计文档：`docs/product/p2-proactive-audit.md`（本 PR）
- 前序：#426 / #427（提醒文案双语，未合入）

---

### 用户故事（§5 补齐，第 23 轮）

- 作为提需求的产品负责人（我），我想在提「主动提醒」类功能前先拿到一份可复核的证据，确认它在发布态是否可达，这样我不会把 debug-only 的代码当成已交付能力——#426 / #427 那种「修好却是潜在代码」的情况要能被提前发现，而不是等下一轮审计再翻案。
- 作为目标的所有者（人类），我想看到 P2 具体缺哪几块（发布态触发 / 授权面 / 撤销面）以及每条的 `file:line`，这样我能决定是「先建」还是「先收窄定位」，而不是靠一句「P2 未完成」。

### Version Information

- **审计快照（正文 file:line 的来源）**：`openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate` @ `04621bb`（本单初稿、Bot 评审所用快照）
- **本次维护复核快照**：`main` @ `9eea155aaf82d998d78427e6c615bab2234c288f`（2026-10-31T22:46:30+08:00；本地克隆 `/data/bot/workspace/main24`，detached）
- **复核命令与结果**（在 `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets` 下执行，main@9eea155）：
  - `sed -n '81,82p;105,106p' pages/A2uiHome/bim/BimDailyReminder.ets` → `title: '检查心上事'` / `content: '看看今天有没有需要关注的事项'` / `title: '检查心上事（测试）'` / `content: '10 秒测试提醒'`（中英文设备同一份硬编码，与正文一致）
  - `sed -n '5524,5525p' pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets` → `if (shouldScheduleBimDailyReminder(checkpointWritten, scheduleNext)) {` 与 `void new BimDailyReminder().scheduleNext(now).catch(...)`（唯一排期调用点，落在 `runDailyBimSentinel` 内）
  - `grep -rn "scheduleNext" pages/A2uiHome/bim/BimDailyReminder.ets` → 定义在 `:121`，与本单正文一致
- **设备 / 运行环境**：本单是纯代码 + 文档审计，不依赖真机，也不需要应用在运行态；`[Doc]:` 表单不要求截图，故此处只需标出被审计的版本。

### 📚 Documentation Issue Description

The architecture-gate guide on actual main `a16c43cbde3f22d59c6c2108c5a39abe57b5a4ff` describes bounded constructor/internal-interface proofs but does not explicitly state the file scope of the separate AR01 local-receiver precision published by PR #1032. The independent source review identified the intended broader local precision; the guide should make that distinction visible to contributors.

The PR review suggestion reproduces the distinction with an ordinary checked fixture policy containing no `internal_components`: exact builtin `object.__new__`, `type(value).__name__`, and a provably stable private classmethod defined in the same source file can pass. Cross-file imported/unknown/rebound receivers still fail. This is a documentation and boundary-fixture follow-up, not a newly established product defect or authorization to change checker semantics.

Source suggestion: https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1032#discussion_r4521195351

### Improvement and Fix Suggestions

Explicitly list the accepted local receiver forms, state that this precision applies to checked source independently of `internal_components`, and distinguish it from declared constructor-chain proofs. Add a focused same-file versus cross-file CLI fixture with no internal declarations to pin that scope. Preserve checker/policy/workflow/product bytes and all unknown/private/mutation negative guards. Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A31`.

**Outcome:** One inference/embedding provider dispatch goes through Model Gateway with true incremental events and truthful normalized usage/failure evidence.

**Owner:** Model Gateway owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- No second execution/terminal owner or application approval policy in a Gateway.
- No whole legacy daemon or opaque runtime wrapper.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve One inference/embedding provider dispatch goes through Model Gateway with true incremental events and truthful normalized usage/failure evidence, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/models.py::_OpenAIClient; OpenAIEmbedder; OpenAIContinuityJudge; OpenAISummarizer` into `server/model_gateway/proxy.py; server/model_gateway/transport.py; server/model_gateway/evidence.py`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/model_gateway/proxy.py; server/model_gateway/transport.py; server/model_gateway/evidence.py

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/models.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/models.py) — `_OpenAIClient; OpenAIEmbedder; OpenAIContinuityJudge; OpenAISummarizer`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/core/foundation/llm/model.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/core/foundation/llm/model.py) — `Model.invoke; Model.stream`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Provider parameters, typed error cause, correlation and supported configuration
- Current permission and trusted endpoint/credential ceilings

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Direct provider execution from Harness and old orchestration
- Gateway-local run terminal, consent conversation or budget balance

**Writable boundary:**
- server/model_gateway/proxy.py
- server/model_gateway/transport.py
- server/model_gateway/evidence.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a31.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A14](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/739)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759), [DM31-A10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/760), [DM31-M04](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/765), [DM31-M26](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/778)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/750), [DM31-A03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/751), [DM31-A04](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/752), [DM31-A05](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/753)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Capture real HTTP/SSE protocol at loopback: delta reaches consumer before DONE; reasoning/tool args remain distinct from answer text.
- Retry attempts carry distinct host-issued IDs; repeated evidence preserves one settlement; null/missing/0 are distinct.
- Invalid endpoint or response is typed; cancelled/failed response can retain known usage without a late Harness result.

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a31

**Participants:** Real Gateway proxy/provider adapter and loopback/captured provider protocol; controlled upstream public caller in the owner-local suite. Actual AS/Host/Store integration is G07/A25, not a prerequisite to extracting this provider boundary. No live vendor/device pass.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [x] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [x] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [x] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [x] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [x] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [x] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** models, streaming, accounting, routing embedding. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR-0004, AR01, AR04, GC-13, GC-16.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

## 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

Asking "看一下star情况" (check the repository stars) is misrouted: instead of a star count it returns an unrelated daily-news task message and exposes an internal scheduling field `push_at` to the user.

Observed (see screenshot):
- User: "看一下star情况"
- Assistant: "每日 AI 科技新闻…进行中，结果稍后补发 (push_at=2026-11-09T07:00:00+08:00)" — unrelated task + internal field leaked.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open DigitalMate mobile.
2. Send: "看一下star情况".
3. Observe the reply.

## Expected result
- The request is routed to the repository star query and returns the star data.
- Internal scheduling fields (e.g. `push_at`) must never be shown in the UI.

## Actual result
- An unrelated daily-news reply is produced and the internal field `push_at=2026-11-09T07:00:00+08:00` is displayed.

## Possible cause (inferred, not code-verified)
- Task routing misclassifies the intent; the outbound serializer does not strip internal/scheduling fields before rendering. This is also an information-exposure issue.

- App: DigitalMate (package `com.jiuwen.digitalmate`), mobile client
- Platform: Android phone
- Timezone: Asia/Shanghai
- Observed at: 2026-11-09 08:07–08:09 (Asia/Shanghai), captured from on-device screenshots (1080x2440)
- Component: chat answer rendering / task execution / session lifecycle
- Observed time: 08:08:15

- Recommend stripping internal scheduling fields at a single outbound/gateway layer rather than per call site.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

助手回复正文末尾把内部控制行 `Next:` 及其后的 JSON 数组（包含 `label`、`ask`、`agent_id`、`view`、`ref` 等字段）原样当作普通文本显示，而不是解析为可点击的“下一步建议”按钮或隐藏。每条带建议动作的回复都会在末尾冒出这一段，表现为界面像“坏掉了一样”。本次在 2026-11-08 的本会话中多次复现。

复现步骤：

1. 在 DigitalMate 聊天中发送任意会触发“下一步建议”的消息（例如任务类请求完成后的回复）。
2. 查看助手回复的末尾。
3. 可观察到形如 `Next: [{"label": "...", "ask": "...", "agent_id": "", "view": false, "ref": ""}]` 的原文直接显示在正文里。

预期与实际：

- 预期：`Next:` 控制行及其 JSON 应由前端解析并渲染为可点击的后续建议按钮（或至少隐藏），普通聊天正文只保留自然语言/卡片内容。

closed_recent.body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help. - [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version. - [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed. ### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem 用户多次要求"取消明天的早会"（取消**会议本身**），助手始终只从**提醒**维度回应："当前没有任何待触发的提��任务""那条 9:00 的提醒已删除，没有剩余提醒"，并多轮重复同一结论"会议本身我无法替你取消，需要你在实际使用的会议/日历系统里取消"。 助手从未清晰区分两个可操作对象： 1. **提醒（到点提醒）**：助手可管理，早前已被取消； 2. **会议本身（日历事件/会议）**：因未连接日历/会议集成，助手无写权限，无法取消或删除。 具体问题： - 用户意图是取消**会议**时，助手只回应**提醒**维度（"无待取消项"），未主动说明"我能取消的是提醒（已取消）；会议本身因未连接日历/会议集成、我无写权限，无法取消"； - 助手在早前取消提醒时未警示"取消提醒 ≠ 取消会议"，导致用户误以为提醒取消后会议也随之取消； - 用户重复询问 3 次才得到同一结论，体验差。 复现步骤（对话转录）： 1. 用户："这几天早上九点有早会没" → 助手："明天上午 9:00 有一场 DM 团队线上早会（2026-11-06 09:00-10:00, Asia/Shanghai）…之前设的那个到点提醒已经让我取消了，所以明天 9:00 不会有提醒；另外目前没有连接日历应用，这场会没有写进日历，也无法自动发出邀请。" 2. 用户："取消下明天的早会" → 助手："我查���了，当前没有任何待触发的提醒任务。没有可取消的日历事件…所以这场会本身我无法替你取消，需要你在实际使用的会议/日历系统里取消。" 3. 用户："那明天早上有早会的话帮忙取消一下" → 助手："我查了一下当前提醒列表，是空的。明天确实有早会，但我没法替你取消会议本身…会议本身需要在你自己用的会议/日历系统里取消。" 期望行为： - 用户请求"取消会议"时，助手应先澄清可操作范围：我能管理的是提醒（已取消）；会议本身因未连接日历/会议集成、我无写权限，无法取消； - 主动警示"取消提醒 ≠ 取消会议"；早前取消提醒时应说明"此操作仅删除到点提醒，会议本身仍存在"； - 提供替代路径：引导用户在实际使用的会议/日历系统取消，或建议连接日历集成。 实际行为： - 助手仅从提醒维度回应（"无待提醒/无待取消"），多轮重复同一结论； - 未主动区分"提醒"与"会议本身"两个概念边界，取消提醒时未警示二者不等价。 影响： - 想取消会议的用户得到"无待取消"回应，易误以为"会议已取消"或"助手听不懂请求"； - 若用户误以为会议已取消而未参会，造成实际影响。 ### Detailed Environment Information Description - 产品：BeeBou / DigitalMate 手机端对话助手 - 系统：HarmonyOS（设备型号与系统版本未在截图中显示） - 场景：多轮对话中请求取消"明天的早会"（会议本身），助手仅从提醒维度回应 ### Version Information - 客户端版本：截图中未显示，待报告者补充 - 会话时间：2026-11-06 上午（截图时间约 10:59） ### Screenshots / Recordings ### Additional Information 关联：与 #456（提醒管理边界）根因同源——助手未清晰区分"提醒"与"日历事件/会议本身"的可操作范围。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

用户询问“现在从公司回小区，地铁和打车哪个快”，并补充起终点“从华为练秋湖回西岑公寓”后，Digital Mate 明确表示没有地图或实时路况工具，却仍给出“打车通常十几分钟就能到”“现在是工作日下午，还没到晚高峰，路况应该还好”等缺少数据依据的结论。

复现步骤：
1. 打开 Digital Mate，输入“现在从公司回小区，地铁和打车哪个快”。
2. 按提示补充“从华为练秋湖回西岑公寓”。
3. 查看助手对打车、地铁耗时和当前路况的比较结果。

预期结果：
- 应调用可用的地图、路线规划或联网搜索能力，基于起终点和当前时间提供有依据的路线、距离、耗时及费用比较，并注明数据时间和不确定性。
- 如果相关能力不可用，应明确限制，仅提供一般性选择原则，不应编造具体通勤时长、实时路况或当前时段。

实际结果：助手在没有地图或实时路况数据的情况下，给出具体通勤时长及当前时段、路况判断，可能误导用户的出行决策。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 产品：Digital Mate 手机端
- 系统：HarmonyOS
- 设备型号及系统版本：未提供
- 场景：打车与地铁通勤方式比较

### Additional Information

业界 Agent 在相同问题下通过联网检索给出了起终点识别、距离、预计耗时、费用和地铁路线说明，可作为对照。建议检查 Digital Mate 的路线规划/地图工具接入、当前时间上下文，以及缺少实时数据时的回答约束，避免将推测表述为事实。

### Version Information

- versionName：0.1.0
- versionCode：10006

### Screenshots / Recordings

**图 1：Digital Mate（我们的产品）当前表现**——声明无地图或实时路况工具，仍给出具体通勤时长和当前路况判断。

closed_recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

位置依赖类查询（天气、附近推荐等）在当前客户端上永远只能回退到手动选城市：对话中问"今天今天的天气怎么样？"，助手不尝试获取设备位置、也**从不发起系统定位权限请求**，而是直接弹出城市选择提问卡（上海 / 北京 / 广州 / Other）。全新安装或用户未在系统设置中手动授权的情况下，应用自身流程里没有任何一步会请求定位权限，agent 侧也没有可用的定位工具，因此"当前位置"这一上下文永远缺失。

与 #205 的区别（为何另开）：#205 的复现前提是"应用已获得位置权限"，问题在 **agent 不使用**已有位置；本 issue 指出的是更底层的缺口——**客户端没有定位权限请求流程、也没有定位能力**，#205 的前提在产品自身流程中根本不成立。两者需要分别修复：本 issue 修客户端能力与授权流程，#205 修 agent 侧的位置上下文使用。

动机：定位是天气/附近类高频查询的默认上下文；缺少它，每次查询都要用户手动选城市，且"今天天气"这类隐含"我所在地"的问题无法被正确理解。

### Design Ideas

考虑过的方案：

1. **客户端定位能力 + 按需授权（推荐）**：客户端声明定位权限并提供取位置接口；首次位置依赖查询时触发系统授权弹窗。授权后以当前城市作为默认上下文直接回答，不再弹城市选择卡。
2. **拒绝/不可用时的降级**：用户拒绝授权或定位失败时，明确告知定位状态（"未获得定位权限"），再回退到城市选择卡；并记住用户选择的城市作为后续默认值。
3. **最小替代**：仅在城市选择卡中增加"使用当前位置"选项。缺点：仍依赖客户端先具备定位能力与授权流程，无法独立成立，建议作为方案 1 的 UI 组成部分而非替代。

### Involved Public APIs

- 客户端需新增定位权限声明与取位置接口（系统权限 API），并向 agent 会话注入位置上下文（如会话 context 增加 location 字段：城市/经纬度/精度/授权状态）。
- 提问卡组件可选扩展"使用当前位置"选项。
- 对现有对话协议为增量变更：位置字段缺失时 agent 行为保持现状（回退城市选择），不破坏旧客户端。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- 与 #205（agent 侧位置使用）互补：本 issue 提供位置来源，#205 消费位置上下文；两者合并验证才能覆盖"附近医院"场景。
- 天气查询链路（参见 #337 城市天气服务）：位置上下文决定查询城市。
- 提问卡 / 澄清问题组件：降级路径复用现有城市选择卡。

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. **首次授权流**：全新安装、未授权状态下问"今天天气怎么样" → 应触发系统定位权限请求（而非直接弹城市选择卡）。
2. **授权后**：授予权限后重复查询 → 直接以当前城市回答天气，不再询问城市；回答中城市与设备实际位置一致。
3. **拒绝后降级**：拒绝授权 → 明确提示"未获得定位权限/定位不可用"，回退城市选择卡；选择某城市后，后续同类查询默认沿用该城市（记住选择）。
4. **定位失败**：模拟定位超时/无信号 → 提示定位状态并回退城市选择，不静默失败、不编造城市。
5. **回归 #205 场景**：授权状态下问"我去看哪里的医生更合适" → agent 应直接使用当前位置推荐，不再反问城市。
6. **隐私**：位置上下文仅在用户授权后采集，会话中可查授权状态；拒绝后不重试弹窗轰炸（遵循系统权限冷却策略）。

### Additional Information

- 证据截图（天气查询弹城市选择卡、全程无授权请求）由报告者手动补充至本 issue。
- 设备：HarmonyOS 手机端 BeeBou / DigitalMate；会话时间 2026-11-05 上午（截图时间约 10:24）。

| **关键决策与能力责任基线已明确** | [A19 #740](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/740)、[A20 #741](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/741)、[M29 #742](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/742) 已按决策/覆盖清单的原范围验收关闭，后续实现和运行证据仍由原任务图承接。 |

**原生完成数核对：12/103**，上表列明的 12 个 Issue 本次均读回 `CLOSED / COMPLETED`，关闭时间均在 11/07–11/09 内；不把 PR 数当成工作包数，不因新增 T0 行增加完成数。T0 的“已完成”仅对应以上交付；新候选真实部署、完整 unchanged-HAP 对比、全部旧执行器退场和最终目录/文档收敛仍属于 T1–T5 的验收范围。

#### T2/T3 前置退出时间与并行责任（F1）

以下为**计划退出目标，不是已完成或已落实容量的声明**。真实 DAG 沿用 #737，不移动/删除硬依赖；生产者未合入时，依赖消费者的生产集成不得先行。契约明确的实现、夹具、独立审阅和不依赖该契约的修复可提前并发。

| 计划最迟退出 | 实际前置链 | 原 owner / 并行工作线 |
|---|---|---|
| **11/12** | A03 ← A02；A05 ← A02；A14 ← A01 | Store 线、Registry 线、Agent Service policy 合约线分别推进，原接口 owner 协调共享修改。 |
| **11/14** | A04 ← A03；A06 ← A03/A05；A31 ← A14；A32 ← A05 | Session Manager、HostAPI、Model Gateway、Plugin Gateway 四条准备/审阅线；依赖就绪即集成，不等待 T2 日期到来。 |
| **11/15** | A07 ← A04/A06 | Agent Service execution owner。 |
| **11/16** | A08 ← A07 | Agent Service interaction owner。 |
| **11/17** | A09 ← A08/A31/A32 | Server Runtime owner，依赖生产者先合入再完成真实装配验收。 |

协调负责人为 **@Jianyu010 / 主会话**；执行责任沿用原 Issue 的 component owner。主会话下一次更新须为上述每条线登记实际执行负责人/会话、独立审阅者、已承诺可用容量和退出 ETA；尚未落实者写 UNKNOWN 并计入风险，不能将这些角色名称当作已分配资源。T2-a、T2-b 分别判断；A09 尚未整体验收不使已经按原范围完成的 A03/A05 回退为未交付。A09 若提前满足前置与门禁，可提前合入，不等 11/17。

#### #935 的范围与原 owner（F2）

#935 是现有独立产品 Bug，原 assignee 为 **@Evelynn-V**；本 Issue 不更改其指派、决策权、完整范围或 #737 的 103 分母。T1 要求的是相关现象在冻结基线/迁移路径上的归因和回归证据，以及修复迁移新增回归；**不要求 #935 整单关闭或实现其全部 Suggested fix direction**。

维护者已要求处理验收发现的实际 Bug，正常缺陷修复仍可由原 owner 与主会话协调后并行交付，包括在已有契约内修复被复现的错误分类。手动 merge/split/rename、Uncategorized 新兜底、标题策略或训练反馈等新增语义不由此计划自动批准，仍走实际产品/组件 owner 和适用变更控制。把新增产品建议另列不等于放过已复现的基础功能失败：具体门禁失败、迁移回归及阻断性问题必须保留并处置，不能因范围分离改写为 PASS。新修复合入后作为冻结基线的明确增量保留，不静默改旧断言或历史结果。

#### 连续双轮验收、容量与设备租约（F3）

沿用当前仓库 [ACCEPTANCE.md §7](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c19f1370542946bd67f87ded6ff010c1a3607afd/tests/e2e/workflow/ACCEPTANCE.md#L121) 和 [case-catalog.yaml 的 stablePasses](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c19f1370542946bd67f87ded6ff010c1a3607afd/tests/cases/case-catalog.yaml#L47)：适用分组要求**同版本、同构建、同复核条件连续两次完整通过**。目录中的 ready、单次 PASS、核心烟测或重复拷贝运行归档都不能替代稳定通过。

- **11/11 前：** Q04/Q10 QA coordinator 枚举实际 case/tier/group、每侧 A/B 要求、stablePasses、HAP/driver/assertion/构建/后端身份及前置；识别旧基线失败，不能把所有 Qxx 笼统标成同一双跑组。
- **11/14 前：** 用实际基线/已就绪组测量单轮耗时和准备/恢复开销，落实候选时段。租约协调负责人 **@Jianyu010 / 主会话**；执行由现有唯一 emulator/ADX 操作员承担（当前主会话 lane 为 `real_deployment_emulator_acceptance`），由 Q04/Q10 独立 QA coordinator 编排、独立 reviewer 验收。主会话须公布具名 owner、设备/账户、租约凭据范围、A/B 串行时段和替补安排；本计划**没有自动取得未来租约**。没有实际授权/排班则记 BLOCKED/UNKNOWN 并预警。
- **候选锁定必须在包括 A09 在内的全部受影响 T3 最终集成合入之后，内部目标为 11/17 18:00。** 锁定被验收候选和可比条件时，计算剩余容量：各适用完整组每侧所需两轮 + 构建/部署/ADX 隔离/切换/清理/独立审阅/失败重跑。独占设备按串行总工时计算，不能用总 agent 并发数抵消设备时间。若任一受影响 T3 项晚于锁点、准备超过下列专用时段，或包含上述开销的完整组无法装入各轮窗口及保留缓冲，立即重新预测并报告预计延期，不等到 11/22；不得锁定不含最终 T3 集成的旧候选并计入最终通过。
- **准备专用时段：11/18 00:00–12:00，用于构建/部署/ADX 隔离及身份核对，不计完整 PASS。第一轮完整运行窗口：11/18 12:00–11/19 11:59（24 小时）。第二轮完整运行窗口：11/19 12:00–11/20 23:59（36 小时）。** 这是容量安排目标，逐组实际租约时段须由上述 owner 确认；没有实际授权/排班和耗时证据则容量仍为 BLOCKED/UNKNOWN，不表示已预约或已确认可容纳。已更早满足真实前置和可比条件的组可提前双跑。两侧原要求和同条件约束均保留，其他只读/组件/文档任务继续并发。
- **11/21–11/22：** 保留修复、受影响完整组重新双跑及独立总验收容量，不作为默认第二轮窗口。任一次 FAIL/BLOCKED/INVALID、输入/条件变化或采样不完整按现有稳定规则中断连续计数；版本/构建/条件变更后，按新版本/构建和冻结条件为受影响完整组重定基，并重新取得连续两次完整通过，不能把旧组改标为新候选。冻结只约束验收输入，不要求全仓停止并发；合入新行为要明确受影响范围与所需重验。
- Q10 按组/每侧列出两次独立 run ID、版本/构建与条件、完整 case 数、结果及稳定性报告链接。未齐备、失败或历史差异处置单列，**不计为稳定通过**；原门禁要求未满足时不能以一次通过宣布 T4/T5 完成。

#### 主会话每次更新的必填内容

主会话每次对外进度更新都必须**直接更新正文顶部「总体里程碑与当前预测」**：刷新相关行、下个 milestone 的 ETA/达标判断、整体预测、主要风险、证据依据和时间。**正文为当前计划与状态的唯一总览；不得只更新滚动评论。** 评论用于保留已发生的验收、预测变化、blocker 和范围差异的审计历史，并链接回正文；如已有滚动状态评论，应同步摘要而不另立当前状态权威。一次工具调用不是一次进度更新。每次必须包含：

1. **下一个未完成 milestone、目标时间、预计完成时间和能否达标：ON_TRACK / AT_RISK / MISSED。** 预计时间应给具体日期/时间或有依据的范围；无法估计时标 UNKNOWN，并写清欠缺信息、负责人及取得时间，不能默认为按期。
2. **距下个 milestone 的剩余交付、关键路径、当轮验收增量和证据链接。** 分别报告已合入生产调用、已部署版本、客户端实际验收和按原范围关闭的任务；测试数量和草稿数量不能代替这些结果。
3. **延期风险、负责人、解除时间和应对动作。** 为最主要的 1–3 项写明影响、下一步和备用路径；明确哪些独立工作已转去并行，不能只写“仍在推进”。
4. **两周总目标的当前预测与信心。** 保留 11/22 目标，单独给出真实预计完成日；若偏离，要公开偏离天数和恢复措施，不能静默移动目标或减少原验收范围。
5. **可提前交付项。** 主动检查后续里程碑中已解锁的任务并提前实现、审阅和合入；说明真实的共享 owner/资源串行点，避免把日期窗口变成队列。

```text
更新时间（Asia/Shanghai）／实际 main 与候选：
下一个 milestone／目标时间：
预计完成时间（或 UNKNOWN + 缺失信息取得时间）：
能否达标：ON_TRACK | AT_RISK | MISSED
本次可核验交付及证据：
剩余关键路径与所需时间：
主要延期风险：原因／owner／解除 ETA／恢复动作
提前推进和合入的后续任务：
11/22 总目标：预计完成日／信心／偏离及应对
```

#### 压缩总工期的执行方式与预警

- 从第 1 天起并行运行生产集成、独立组件交付、部署/UI、回归/性能/治理；优先复用已审阅的准备包，减少远期无接口草稿和重复基础设施改动。
- 单项先做受影响验证；兼容变更进入协调的集成分支，对明确的整批候选构建/部署和 UI 验收，再通过正常流程合入。常规 UI 核心场景以几分钟为目标，扩展场景约十分钟；完整最终语料仍按 Q04–Q10 执行，不得用烟测替代。
- 明确外部权限、测试账户、G10 管理员执行和旧历史/回滚边界的实际 owner，尽早请求具体输入。共享凭据轮换由其所有者协调；不要公开凭据。
- 若 11/11 首个真实纵向切片未完成，或 11/14 的 T2-a / T2-b 未分别按上述范围退出，或 11/17 A09 原范围/双轮容量与租约仍未就绪，必须把两周总目标重新评为高风险并给出具体纠偏/新预测，不能继续显示绿色。
- 每个三天检查点都复核未来六天的剩余工作量和关键路径，及时重分配可并行能力；保留最后两天的修复/独立验收容量。若已知必做工作无法装入剩余时间，应立即报告延期，不等到最后一天。

#### 初始状态与关闭条件

**初始状态：T1 未完成；两周总目标 AT_RISK（高风险），尚无有依据的最终完工预测。** 当前已知 Hosted 候选尚未完成实际部署和 unchanged-HAP 验收；ADX 隔离/历史兼容、构建资源和管理员执行项仍需归属明确。受控 CI 已有通过证据，普通路径失败/批准的限定接纳、实际 Windows ST、最终候选 source 和部署证据必须按各自作用域记录，不能合称全绿。主会话须在收到本 Issue 后的首次进度更新中以最新事实补全预测。

- [x] T0（11/07–11/09）首批生产基础与协作/验收工具按上方明确范围完成，12 个原始工作包的原生状态已核对。
- [ ] T1 按上述标准验收并回填。
- [ ] T2 按上述标准验收并回填。
- [ ] T3 按上述标准验收并回填。
- [ ] T4 按上述标准验收并回填。
- [ ] T5 / #737 / Q11 最终结论与证据闭环。
- [ ] 各 milestone 的目标、实际时间、风险变化及最终差异保留，可追溯至原任务。

本 Issue 不因建立计划、到达目标日期或部分里程碑完成而关闭。若需要延期，保持开放并更新预测；最终功能、数据、兼容性、性能或强制门禁未通过时不得声称两周目标完成。



**Root发布补充（2026-11-10 12:16:27 UTC）：** 当前C仅为已冻结/独审的两文件受限tag-push恢复候选71d4e6bf（ind80c50067；另验depth1 local-fetch/scope602e906b通过），尚未tag/push/远端CI/full。发布前已按精确替换合并#737的并发架构迁移图与34条类／符号核查两个独立标记区，内容逐字保留；不改变原103工作包/225硬边及14/6/83计数。

### Version Information

- 计划记录日期：2026-11-09；时区 Asia/Shanghai。计划目标至 2026-11-22 23:59。
- 2026-11-09 根据 [bot review F1–F3](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/963#issuecomment-6733046202) 修订依赖退出目标、#935 范围和双轮验收容量；保留两周总目标、非 barrier 规则及既有最终门禁。
- 核对时 main：`c19f1370542946bd67f87ded6ff010c1a3607afd`；Hosted PR #946 当时 head：`4e6e8ed40490de8802f451b6222c7b9a5214f39b`。后续验收必须记录其实际版本，不复用此快照作通过证明。
- 原始需求、硬依赖、冻结基线、权限与最终验收以 #737 及其现有 owner/子任务为准。本 Issue 只跟踪两周推进目标与动态预测；不能推翻既有契约或生产切换授权边界。

items.body:
### Background and Goal Description

上图为 A05 关闭后的 15/5/83 快照。当前进度见下表。

<!-- DM31:ARCHITECTURE-MIGRATION-MAP -->
#### 架构迁移关系图（无进度版）

[![DigitalMate v3.1 旧代码职责到目标组件的拆分与聚合](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/281d4adbc68b7b6d2dd8acf18a12d5c9647e938c/docs/assets/v31-server-migration/architecture-migration-map.png?raw=true)](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/281d4adbc68b7b6d2dd8acf18a12d5c9647e938c/docs/assets/v31-server-migration/architecture-migration-map.svg)

[可编辑 Excalidraw](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/281d4adbc68b7b6d2dd8acf18a12d5c9647e938c/docs/assets/v31-server-migration/architecture-migration-map.excalidraw) · [类／符号级迁移核查与完整索引](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/281d4adbc68b7b6d2dd8acf18a12d5c9647e938c/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/class-migration-checklist.md) · [带日期的进度证据归档](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/281d4adbc68b7b6d2dd8acf18a12d5c9647e938c/docs/verification/v31-migration-map-2026-11-10/README.md)

箭头表示职责迁移，右侧为目标归属；本图不表示已完成。`session_proximity` 按路由、会话、存储和兼容投影拆向不同 owner。文档归档 [PR #1067](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1067)；链接固定到提交，不依赖 PR 合并后才显示。
<!-- /DM31:ARCHITECTURE-MIGRATION-MAP -->

**v3.1 迁移进度：已完成 16/103（15.5%）**

| 原始工作包状态 | 数量 | 统计含义 |
|---|---:|---|
| 已完成 | **16** | 原生 Issue 为 CLOSED / COMPLETED；按原范围验收。 |
